name: golden150

sampling_frame.ordering: hardness: known hard tags desc, low-res first, sha256

coverage_gaps: Occlusion strata (occlusion_other, sunglasses, masked, blur) are known for only 150 of 646 corpus images, all hand-tagged. A full-corpus detector pass did NOT close this: calibrated against those 150 labels, every occlusion signal scored at chance (AUC 0.59-0.68), so no threshold can extend them. Natural-occlusion coverage needs either operator tagging or synthetic generation (synthetic_occlusion.py), not more detection.

`profile` IS derived corpus-wide (AUC 0.782) but at ~0.67 precision it is a shortlist: roughly a third of derived profile media are not profile. Selection uses it for ordering only, and slice_tags_derived is never merged into slice_tags. The operator should confirm pose on the 150 selected images.
Identity labels descend from operator cluster merges, so they are ground truth for naming but must not be reused to score the clustering that produced them.
